status: mechanism test frozen after x-y-time-only feasibility preflight and before state-conditioned vertical output
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims

hypotheses.behavioural_mixture: Repeatable whole-session vertical individuality is largely induced by stable individual differences in the proportions of broad movement-intensity states.
hypotheses.within_state: Individual vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even when self and other profiles are compared under identical horizontal-cell × movement-state weights.

state_definition.speed: Euclidean projected horizontal step distance divided by elapsed seconds for consecutive fixes within a frozen session
state_definition.thresholds: Within each frozen cohort, pooled valid step speeds are divided at empirical 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles.
state_definition.event_assignment: The endpoint fix of each valid step receives its movement-state label; first fixes, non-positive intervals and intervals >1800 s are excluded from the state-conditioned estimator.
state_definition.vertical_centering: For every frozen session, subtract that session's median primary vertical coordinate computed from all retained numeric-height events before selecting state-valid endpoint fixes.

estimator.common_weighting: For joint 5-km cell × movement-state strata supported by both self and other conditional profiles, compute the equal-session self training distribution over joint strata and apply exactly those same weights to both self and other vertical profiles.
estimator.rationale: If whole-session individuality is caused only by different proportions of movement states, then self and other within-state vertical profiles should converge when evaluated under identical joint-stratum weights.
estimator.target_scoring: Score the centered residual-height distribution of target events whose joint cell × state stratum is supported by both predictors.

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived movement states
calibration.preserve: all within-session x-y-time-state-residual-z observations and exact original session-count multiset per label
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact expected evaluable n; observed-minus-null-mean common joint-cell-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

synthesis.primary_statistic: number of the five comparative panels passing the frozen state-conditioned identity rule

decision_matrix.4_or_5_pass: Strong evidence that broad movement-state mixture alone is insufficient as a general explanation; comparative individuality persists within movement-intensity states.
decision_matrix.2_or_3_pass: Mixed mechanism: broad movement-state mixture may explain part of the pattern, while within-state individuality remains in some systems.
decision_matrix.0_or_1_pass: Consistent with broad movement-state composition being sufficient for much of the comparative signal, but power/support loss must be considered before a causal conclusion.

synthesis.descriptive_attenuation: Report state-conditioned calibrated excess beside the already-frozen centered-shape calibrated excess (+0.443, +0.177, +0.111, +0.118, +0.574 for Eidolon, Hypsignathus, P. hastatus 2022, 2023, 2016). Do not use attenuation ratios as an inferential rescue.

claim_boundary: Movement-intensity states are an x-y-time proxy, not validated commuting/foraging/social behavioural labels.
Persistence supports within-state individuality relative to this proxy, not a specific morphology, memory, resource or atmospheric cause.
Loss of significance after conditioning is not by itself proof of behavioural-mixture causation because state conditioning reduces support.
No result from this extension modifies the frozen v0.3.8 submission manuscript before submission.
stop_rule: Do not change q3_dt1800 state definition, vertical centering, bins, joint support, weighting, minimum scored events, expected n, panel B/seeds or pass criteria after any state-conditioned vertical output is opened.
Retain all non-passing panels and do not substitute q2 or dt3600 preflight alternatives.
Do not add a post-hoc state classifier if the frozen proxy fails.
